response.sql: WITH per_product AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.production_type_code, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_cnt, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items) AS item_share FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.production_type_code), per_type AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(pp.avg_qty) AS avg_qty, AVG(pp.item_cnt) AS avg_item_cnt, AVG(pp.item_share) AS avg_item_share FROM per_product pp JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = pp.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS avg_product_quantity, AVG(avg_item_cnt) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share FROM per_type
